name: Gig Tax Pros
subtitle: Mileage, expenses & gig offers
promotionalText: Keep your driving records, review receipts and compare gig offers using your own vehicle costs and pay goals.
description:
Organize your independent driving work with Gig Tax Pros.

TRACK YOUR RECORDS
Start and end drives, classify mileage, add manual trips and keep income and expenses together. Optional driving assistance uses location and motion to help detect drives and remind you about expense stops.

KEEP RECEIPTS WITH EXPENSES
Choose or scan a receipt, review the suggested merchant and amount, and attach it to an expense. Receipt text recognition happens on your device.

REVIEW GIG OFFERS
Choose an offer screenshot or enter the details yourself. Review pay, total distance, time and costs before saving a comparison. Missing information stays unknown. Optional screen sharing reads visible offer text after you explicitly start Apple's sharing control. You make every acceptance decision in the original gig app.

PLAN WITH YOUR OWN ASSUMPTIONS
Set vehicle costs and hourly goals, compare estimates and explore the built-in practice guide. Estimates depend on the details you provide.

KEEP YOUR WORK AVAILABLE
Use the local journal without a client account and export your records. An optional invited client connection shares supported records with your firm's configured workspace. Provider and firm connections depend on availability and authorization.

Background mileage requires location permission. GPS gaps, permission changes and force-quitting can leave incomplete records. Review your mileage and imported details.

Gig Tax Pros is independent of Uber, Lyft and other gig platforms. It does not automatically accept jobs, read other apps' private notification inboxes or file tax returns. Estimates are planning tools, not individualized tax advice or guaranteed earnings.
releaseNotes: First release of Gig Tax Pros: mileage records, income and expense organization, receipt review, gig-offer comparisons and a guided practice experience.
